choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: neither is designated primary or singled out in the abstract/introduction, and both summarize the same unadjusted full-sample novelty contrast. Although Table 2 supplies arm means, participant-level SDs and Cohen’s d, arm-specific counts are unreported and neither record has data_stats, so rule 3’s stated requirements are unmet; the remaining rules do not distinguish the same session, arms and task.
